listing.name: Dustkeeper XO
listing.summary: This mod is a plug-in for the Second-in-Command mod by Lukas04, implementing an Executive Officer aptitude for the Dustkeeper Contingency faction from Secrets of the Frontier by Inventor Raccoon. The player can hire their own Executive Officers from the Dustkeeper Contingency at their Holdout Forgeship.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a faction-specific Executive Officer aptitude that enhances automated ship efficiency based on the number of human-officered ships in the fleet.

description:
Download Link

Current version: 1.6.0

Mod releases with changelogs are located here

This mod is a plug-in for the

Second-in-Command

mod by Lukas04, implementing an Executive Officer aptitude for the Dustkeeper Contingency faction from

Secrets of the Frontier

by Inventor Raccoon. The player can hire their own Executive Officers from the Dustkeeper Contingency at their Holdout Forgeship.

The Dustkeeper aptitude focuses on combining automated ships with human crew, gaining more automated ship points depending on the amount human-officered ships you have in your fleet.

This mod should be fine to add midgame, but Executive Officers will only spawn at the start of each month so depending on the date in game you might need to let time advance a bit before they'll appear.

Preview of mod features and skills (Now outdated):

Spoiler

[close]

Future plans:

SpoilerImplement additional abilities to replace or compliment the existing ones lifted from the normal Automation aptitude. I'm soliciting ideas that would fit with the general Dustkeeper theme!

Also get feedback about the abilities beyond what I've solicited on the discord so far.[close]

This mod requires both Second in Command and Secrets of the Frontier to function, as well as their associated dependencies.

Personal note:

SpoilerThis is my first foray into modding for this game and it's been a fun experience, especially considering I only started playing a bit over a month ago. It really, really feels like it's been longer than that considering how much I've been playing.[close]
